_comment: motionbgs.com, described 2026-10-14 from the site as it answers from this machine.
This is the first VIDEO source: what a card's 入库 fetches is an .mp4, not a picture, which is why
the file names a `hero` and why 'ext' is mp4.
HOW MUCH IS THERE. The sitemap lists 14,828 urls: 7,916 desktop wallpaper pages, 4,682 under
/mobile/, 319 tag pages. /4k/ runs to page 213 (binary-searched: page 213 answers 200 with 17
cards, page 214 does not print a next link) and 212x36+17 = 7,649 clips, so /4k/ is not a curated
slice - it is the whole desktop catalog, and the tags are cross-cut views over it. /tag:anime/ is
107 pages (last one 26 cards) = 3,842.
NO PUBLISHED TOTAL. The site's own pager is two arrows and nothing else (class=pag with Prev/Next
only), no page numbers, no count anywhere on the page; a detail h1 says '(Page 107)' and stops
there. So last_page can only ever see askedPage+1, which is enough for 下一页 to work and to stop
dead-on at the end (page 213 prints only 212, so max(213,212)=213), but the bar cannot know 213 in
advance. Out-of-range pages are clamped rather than 404ed (page 400 serves page 213's content with
pager ['213']) - harmless here, because 下一页 is only offered while page < lastPage.
So the file says so: rolling_pages=true makes the window draw '‹ 4 ›' instead of a numbered
window whose last cell would read as a total of 5.
robots.txt: 'User-agent: * / Allow: /' with only /ajax/*, /admin/*, /a2/* disallowed. Everything
this source touches - the listing, /media/<id>/*.mp4 and /i/c/*/*.jpg - is under the Allow.
Cloudflare, no X-RateLimit header, so 2000 ms is our own courtesy, matched to wallhaven.
NO TEXT SEARCH. /?s=cat answers 200 with the DEFAULT listing (first card 'Wandering Samurai', no
cat in sight) and /?s=cat&page=2 returns the same 112450 bytes and the same first card, so the
parameter is ignored. /search/?q= is a 404. Hence ask=false and browsing by section.
A section is a path and so is its page number: /4k/ is page 1, /4k/2/ is page 2, and /4k/2 (no
trailing slash) 301s to /4k/2/, which Qt follows. /4k// is a 404, so the page number rides on the
url as {nextpage} and comes out empty on page 1 rather than as a doubled slash.
TWO FAMILIES OF CARD, and the first version of this file only read one of them. Each card is
<a title="..." href=/slug> (unquoted) followed by a <picture> whose srcset names the media file:
new   /i/c/546x308/media/10319/yamada-tayama.3840x2160.jpg   the wallpaper's size is in the name
old   /i/c/546x308/media/1397/goku-ultra-instinct_2.jpg      no size, and the name is not the slug
Requiring the '.<WxH>' segment silently dropped 28 of the 36 cards on /tag:dragon-ball/ - the grid
came back nearly full and nothing said a card was missing. The expression now makes that segment
optional (group 6) and rebuilds the thumb from groups 3-6: 230 rebuilt thumbs across six pages
(/4k/ 1 and 2, /tag:anime/ 1 and 107, /tag:dragon-ball/, the home grid), 0 differing from the url
the page itself printed; card coverage 36/36, 36/36, 26/26, 60/60, 36/36, 36/36.
Each card prints two jpg srcsets (a 1x and a 2x crop) plus their webp twins; anchoring on
'.jpg type=image/jpeg' rules the webp twins out and taking the first jpg leaves one match per card.
The widest <a>...srcset gap measured across those pages is 426 bytes against the 600 allowed.
The clip is /media/<id>/<name>.<WxH>.mp4 - the media path off the card, the rung from the
resolution option. Rungs probed 2026-10-14 on a 20-card random sample drawn from three different
pages: 960x540 present 20/20, 1920x1080 present 20/20, 3840x2160 present 15/20, and the five
misses were all low-id (older) wallpapers - 2575 nezuko-kamado-demonic-look, 3428 sp-onikiri, 446
mika-kagehira, 1703 beidou-genshin-impact, 4613 naoko-kirino-pumpkin-night. So the default is
1920x1080: a quarter of the catalog has no 4K file, and a default that 404s on one card in four is
worse than a default that is one dropdown click away from being wrong. 1280x720 and 2560x1440 are
absent on every sample, so they are not offered at all.
Sizes as served (content-length): 10319 yamada-tayama 1.0 / 9.7 / 19.4 MB, 10323 symphony-of-stars
1.0 / 11.5 / 28.8 MB, 10282 geralt-yennefer-witcher-3 0.8 / 13.7 / 27.6 MB, and the older 1397
goku-ultra-instinct_2 0.1 / 0.7 / 5.5 MB.
`hero` is the same media file as a jpg at a fixed /i/c/1920x1080/ crop: 59-149 KB measured on both
families (1397 goku-ultra-instinct_2 59 KB, 10319 yamada-tayama.3840x2160 148 KB, 2156
fuhua-honkais-swiftest-shadow 149 KB) against 19.4 MB for the .mp4 of the same wallpaper. The crop
size in that path is a request, not a label - /i/c/1280x720/, /1920x1080/, /2560x1440/ and
/3840x2160/ of one media all answer 200 (82 / 148 / 213 / 405 KB). Without a hero the big pane
would sit on the card's 546x308 thumb blown up to 1360 px, and the window is right to refuse to
fetch a video as a preview.
The capture groups must not leave a doubled slash in these urls: with one, the crop in the hero
path is ignored and the CDN answers the 4K file instead of the 1920x1080 one (414,212 B against
the 148 KB measured for the same frame) - a card hover costing 2.8x the bytes it names.
Categories are /4k/ plus the 34 tags the site's own navigation lists. Every one was fetched on
2026-10-14 and answered 200 with cards the expression matched: 36 on most, 30 hololive, 27 berserk
/ princess-connect / tokyo-ghoul, 23 hatsune-miku, 32 my-hero-academia. /gifs/ and /mobile/ were
dropped on measurement, not on taste: /gifs/ has no card markup at all (0 srcsets) and /mobile/'s
cards are 235x418 crops of 720x1280 wallpapers - portrait phone pictures this desktop cannot use.
